SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT
Date. January 16, 1935.
File No. K.C.L.

Subject. Reference the attached letter from the Consul-General for
Switzerland relative (A) to one Adolf Landau and (B) the China
Mutual Life Insurance Company, Ltd.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by.

(A) Aaron Landau alias Adolf Landau who was born of
Russian parents in Jerusalem in 1872 is in possession of
documents which describe him as being of Turkish nationality.
On August 8, 1931 he applied to the H.B.M.
Consulate for permission to reside permanently in Hongkong
and produced a certificate No. 381 issued on August 6, 1931
by the Bureau of Public Safety, Shanghai, to which the
necessary vise was affixed.
At present Landau is operating a cafe in Hong-
kong and is assisted in its management by one of his sons.
Another son is employed in Andersen, Meyer & Company,
Hongkong.

(B) Enquiries regarding the China Mutual Life
Insurance Company Ltd. indicate that such a concern was
formed in 1898 by J. A. Wattie and a group of Chinese who
provided the necessary capital. The business was
registered with the British Consulate and in 1899 was
registered under the Hongkong Ordnances. The concern at
first made money but by 1921 there appears to have been a
certain amount of dissension among the various directors
over bad business with the result that the firm's interests
were sold out to the Sun Life Assurance Company of Canada,
the offices of which are situated at No. 218 Szechuen Road.

D.S.I. Golder
D. S. I.
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch)

特务科第二股
报告
日期：1935年1月16日。
档案号：K.C.L.

事由：关于随附的瑞士总领事来函，涉及 (A) 阿道夫·兰多（Adolf Landau）一人，及 (B) 华安合群人寿保险公司有限公司（China Mutual Life Insurance Company, Ltd.）。

由副督察戈尔德（Golder）呈报 转呈人：

(A) 亚伦·兰多（Aaron Landau），又名阿道夫·兰多（Adolf Landau），1872年出生于耶路撒冷，父母为俄国人，现持有表明其为土耳其国籍的文件。1931年8月8日，他向英国驻华领事馆申请永久居住香港的许可，并出示了由上海公安局于1931年8月6日签发的第381号证明书，该证明书已加盖必要的签证。
目前，兰多在香港经营一家咖啡馆，由其一名儿子协助管理。另一名儿子受雇于香港的和记洋行（Andersen, Meyer & Company）。

(B) 关于华安合群人寿保险公司有限公司的查询显示，该公司由 J. A. Wattie 和一群提供必要资本的中国人于1898年成立。该企业在英国领事馆注册，并于1899年根据香港法例注册。该公司起初盈利，但到1921年，各位董事之间似乎因业务不佳而产生了一定程度的分歧，结果将该公司的权益出售给加拿大永明人寿保险公司（Sun Life Assurance Company of Canada），其办事处位于四川路218号。

副督察 戈尔德
D. S. I.
副警务总监（特务科）

January 22 38.

Consul-General for Switzerland,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your J.-VIII 5/25/64 of January 12, 1935, on the subjects
of Mr. A. Landau and the China Mutual Life Insurance
Company, Ltd, and in reply to state as follows :-

Aaron Landau alias Adolf Landau was born of
Russian parents in Jerusalem in 1872, and now claims
Turkish nationality. On August 8, 1931 he secured
permission from H.B.M. Consulate in Shanghai to enter
Hongkong and now operates a cafe in that colony. One
of his sons assists him in the cafe and another is employed
by Andersen, Meyer & Co., Hongkong.

The China Mutual Life Insurance Company Ltd was
established in 1898 by J.A. Wattie and a group of Chinese.
The firm secured registration under the Hongkong Ordinances
in 1899. It carried on business successfully until 1921
when its interests were sold to the Sun Life Assurance
Company of Canada, No. 215 Des Voeux Road.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(sgd) F. W. Garrard
Commissioner of Police.

亚伦·兰多，又名阿道夫·兰多，1872年出生于耶路撒冷，父母为俄国人，现声称拥有土耳其国籍。1931年8月8日，他获得英国驻上海领事馆进入香港的许可，目前在该殖民地经营一家咖啡馆。他的一个儿子在咖啡馆协助他，另一个受雇于香港的和记洋行（Andersen, Meyer & Co.）。

华安合群人寿保险公司有限公司由 J.A. Wattie 和一群中国人于1898年创立。该公司于1899年根据香港法例获得注册。公司业务一直顺利经营，直至1921年将其权益出售给加拿大永明人寿保险公司，地址为德辅道215号。

谨此奉复，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

（签名）F. W. Garrard
警务总监。

Sir,
I respectfully beg to report with reference to
attached Memo referring to Adolf Landau manufacturing
spurious liquors and disposing of same without a license,
that I had his residence kept under observation but no
cases resembling that of liquor cases or otherwise left
or entered the premises. He only occupies part of the
house, having two Sub-Tenants. There is no spurious
liquors manufactured on the premises.
He is a Commission Agent and indirectly deals in
Wines and Spirits. If a Customer places an order with
him to Import a certain quantity of liquor from Europe
he takes the order on Commission. On arrival of the
cargo it is placed in a Godown and he receives the Bill
of Lading which he hands to the Customer to take delivery of.
On enquiry at the Savoy Hotel the Proprietor states
that recently he purchased a barrel of oil from Landau,
which is the only business transaction between them.
The Proprietor has a working arrangement with Messrs
Yue Dah & Coy, Compadore Broadway, whereby he receives
all his Wines and Spirits from that Firm.
Landau is said to be connected with or the Proprietor
of the Shanghai Stage Newspaper, his Offices being situate
in the premises previously known as the Oliver Buildings,
Nanking Road.
Your Obedient Servant,
Chief Detective Inspector, John J. Prosser
C. I. D. D.S. 66.

26th. February, 1908.

Sir, Adolph Landau

Referring to your letter of 17th. instant, I have the honour
to inform you that Adolph Landau at one time opened the business
of an auctioneer in Shanghai, and absconded with money belonging
to people who had entrusted goods to him to sell. He returned
after about three years absence but no action was taken against
him as the amounts were small and the complainants were averse
to prosecution. He opened on his return a house which he named
the "China Business Exchange". He was in a short time
summoned for debt to the Chinese Mixed Court as no Consul would
acknowledge him. He did not answer the summons and left Shanghai
eventually to avoid arrest. He has a sister in Shanghai, a Mrs
Widler, who keeps a boarding house at No. 8, Quinsan Gardens.

I am,
Sir,
Your obedient servant.

The Chief of Police Captain Superintendent.
City of Manila,
Manila. P. I.

REPORT ON Landau, Alleged to Assist Russian Deserters Leaving
Shanghai.

Made by D.S.Givens. Forwarded by

Sir,
Regarding attached, I beg to report that the Bristol
Hotel is owned by an Austrian woman named Mrs Seif. Landau,
who occupies a portion of the building, is a clerk in the Palace
Hotel. He is a Swiss under American protection.
Enquiries have failed to elicit any confirmation of the
information that he assists Russians who are leaving Shanghai
to avoid military service. The man Jivitovski lived in the
Bristol Hotel, but left it some days before the S.S. China
sailed.
Landau professes to be pro-ally and has often assisted in
making inquiries. He told me of the presence of Jivotovski
in the Bristol Hotel, whom he thought might be Albeke about
whom I was inquiring at the time, and arranged to have me see
him. Jivotovski is about 22 years old, below medium height,
and thin. He has a haggard appearance, and looks more like
a Frenchman or Italian than Russian. He knows a little
English, but speaks French fluently. A watch on Landau when
will be kept
the S.S. 'China' is about to sail again may reveal something.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D.S.Givens
Detective Sergeant.

Chief Detective Inspector.

先生，
关于附件，谨报告布里斯托尔酒店（Bristol Hotel）由一名名为塞夫夫人（Mrs Seif）的奥地利妇女拥有。兰多占用该建筑的一部分，他是汇中饭店的一名职员。他是受美国保护的瑞士人。
经查询，未能证实他协助离开上海以逃避兵役的俄罗斯人的情报。Jivitovski 这个人住在布里斯托尔酒店，但在“中国”号轮船（S.S. China）启航前几天离开了那里。
兰多自称亲协约国，并经常协助进行调查。他告诉我 Jivotovski 在布里斯托尔酒店的情况，他认为 Jivotovski 可能是我当时正在查询的 Albeke，并安排我与他会面。Jivotovski 约22岁，中等偏矮身材，消瘦。他面容憔悴，看起来更像法国人或意大利人而不是俄罗斯人。他懂一点英语，但法语流利。当“中国”号轮船即将再次启航时，对兰多的监视可能会揭示一些情况。

CENTRAL POLICE
19th April, 1917.

D.S.I.Givens.

Sir,
    On 19th inst. Adolphe Landau called on the Chief Detective
Inspector and stated that he was born in Jerusalem of Russian
parents on October 18th, 1872, and about 40 years ago went with
his parents to Singapore, where they started a factory for
canning pine apples in Albert Street. He came to Shanghai in
1901, and started business as an auctioneer in Rue du Consulate,
French Town, and registered in the French Consulate. In 1902,
he married a British lady named Brander by whom he has two sons
and two daughters aged from 15 to 4. He gave up the auctioneering
business in 1903 and went to India. He then went to Rangoon,
where he established a pine apple canning factory. He left
there in 1908, and came again to Shanghai. After remaining
for a few months, he went to Bangkok, where he remained for 8
years as manager of the Astor Hotel. During his stay in
Bangkok, he was known to Mr. Skinner-Turner, Judge of H.B.M.s
Supreme Court.
    Landau was a night watchman at the Paris exposition. He
was once a book-keeper in a store in Manila, and has visited the
United States.
    Landau was registered in the French Consulate when he first
came here, and has never been registered in any other consulate.
    Landau came to Shanghai from Bangkok in September 1915, and
has been employed for over a year as day clerk in the Palace
Hotel.
    Landau has hazel eyes, brown hair and is quite bald. He is
4 feet 11 inches high, and is a Jew.

                        Your obedient servant,

（签名）
pages.zh:
中央巡捕房
1917年4月19日。

吉文斯副侦探督察（D.S.I. Givens）。

先生：
    本月19日，阿道夫·兰多（Adolphe Landau）拜会了首席侦探督察，并陈述如下：他于1872年10月18日出生于耶路撒冷，父母均为俄国人；约40年前随父母前往新加坡，他们在那里阿尔伯特街（Albert Street）开办了一家菠萝罐头厂。他于1901年来到上海，在法租界领事馆路（Rue du Consulate）从事拍卖商业务，并在法国领事馆进行了注册。1902年，他娶了一位名叫布兰德（Brander）的英国女士为妻，育有两子两女，年龄从15岁至4岁不等。他于1903年放弃拍卖业务前往印度。随后他去了仰光，在那里建立了一家菠萝罐头厂。他于1908年离开仰光，再次来到上海。停留数月后，他前往曼谷，在那里担任阿斯特酒店（Astor Hotel）经理达8年之久。在曼谷期间，英国陛下最高法院法官斯金纳-特纳先生（Mr. Skinner-Turner）认识他。
    兰多曾在巴黎博览会担任夜间看守人。他曾在马尼拉的一家商店担任簿记员，并曾访问过美国。
    兰多初来此地时在法国领事馆注册，此后从未在任何其他领事馆注册。
    兰多于1915年9月从曼谷来到上海，已在皇宫饭店（Palace Hotel）受雇担任日间职员一年多。
    兰多拥有淡褐色眼睛、棕色头发，且完全秃顶。身高4英尺11英寸，系犹太人。

                        您顺从的仆人，

（签名）
